text: dsh-kb-rag（DSH 插件，支持任意使用 DSH 工具注册表的客户端）：为本地知识库工作流提供一组工具。插件在 DSH 的 tools 注册表中注册 kb_query、kb_ingest、kb_crawl 和 kb_related，并将请求转发给本机 kb-rag Python 脚本。用户可以检索 ChromaDB 中的文档片段、把文档目录切块入库、将一组网页抓取为 Markdown，再围绕主题或已知文档查找关联内容。适合希望在 DSH 会话中查阅和整理本机资料的用户。需要配置 Python 和 kb-rag 目录；知识库处理还依赖 Ollama 与 bge-m3。

dsh-kb-rag adds local knowledge tools to DSH: search a ChromaDB library, ingest documents, crawl web pages to Markdown, and find related material. It forwards requests to kb-rag Python scripts. Configure Python and kb-rag; processing also needs Ollama and bge-m3.
想从自己的本地资料里检索相关段落。
把一整个文档目录导入向量知识库，方便之后提问。
给我一组网页链接，抓取并整理成 Markdown。
根据某个主题从知识库里找相关文档和内容。
我知道一份文档的名字，想看看有哪些资料和它相关。
Search my local documents for passages relevant to a question.
Crawl a list of web pages into Markdown so I can add them to my notes.
Find related documents starting from a topic or a document I already know.
dsh-kb-rag 的功能「本地语义检索」：通过 kb_query 按问题或关键词查询本机 ChromaDB 向量库，返回带来源、块编号和相似度的片段；可设置返回数量，范围为 1 到 20。
dsh-kb-rag 的功能「文档目录入库」：通过 kb_ingest 将文档目录切块并交给 kb-rag 入库，可指定块大小、重叠量、按标题切分、强制重建或先重置向量库。
dsh-kb-rag 的功能「网页批量抓取」：通过 kb_crawl 提供 URL 列表或 URL 文件，将网页抓取输出为 Markdown；可以指定输出目录和请求间隔。
dsh-kb-rag 的功能「关联资料推荐」：通过 kb_related 以主题关键词或已知文档名为起点查找关联资料，并可选择图谱式知识漫游。

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · @dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag：**Local-first RAG knowledge tools for DSH** — thin tool wrapper around the
[kb-rag](https://github.com/YuMu247/kb-rag) Python pipeline (Ollama bge-m3 +
ChromaDB + SiYuan). Four tools, all on-premises, zero API cost, your documents
never leave the machine.

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · @dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag：| Tool | What it does | Backing script |
|---|---|---|
| `kb_query` | Semantic search over your local vector DB (top-k chunks with source + similarity) | `query.py --json` |
| `kb_ingest` | Ingest a docs directory into ChromaDB (incremental, manifest hash-idempotent; Shiyu notes auto-stripped of front-matter + machine layer) | `ingest.py` |
| `kb_crawl` | Batch-crawl URLs to clean Markdown (Scrapling + markdownify) | `crawl.py` |
| `kb_related` | Related-document recommendations: retrieval-style, graph-style knowledge walk, or from a known doc | `related.py` |
@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · Install：```bash

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · requires a dsh build with the `dsh plugin` subcommand; <profile> = tui/headless/web/...：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:YuMu247/dsh-kb-rag
dsh --profile <profile>        # restart: kb_query / kb_ingest / kb_crawl / kb_related injected
```

Peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`) are provided
by the dsh profile.

text: @dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · Prerequisites (one-time, on the host)：```bash

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · 1. the Python pipeline：git clone https://github.com/YuMu247/kb-rag
pip install -r kb-rag/requirements.txt
@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · 2. Ollama + embedding model：ollama pull bge-m3        # ~1.2GB

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · 4. ingest something, then ask：python kb-rag/ingest.py --docs /path/to/docs
```

Optional (Windows daily sync): `examples/sync_daily.cmd` in the kb-rag repo
starts Ollama, syncs Shiyu video notes, ingests and imports into SiYuan.

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · Tool arguments：- **kb_query** — `query` (required), `k` (default 5, max 20). Returns `{ok, count, chunks:[{source, chunk, similarity, text}]}`.
- **kb_ingest** — `docs` (default `<kb-rag>/docs`), `force`, `reset`, `heading`, `chunkSize` (default 512), `overlap` (default 64). Returns `{ok, summary}`.
- **kb_crawl** — `urls` (array) or `urlsFile` (path), `out` (default `<kb-rag>/out`), `delay` (default 1.5s, min 0.2). Returns `{ok, summary, outDir}`.
- **kb_related** — `seed` or `fromDoc` (exactly one), `k` (default 5), `graph` (>0 enables graph-style walk). Returns `{ok, text}`.

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · Plugin config：All keys optional, set in the profile plugin config:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pythonCmd` | `python` (win) / `python3` (other) | Python executable |
| `kbRagDir` | `KB_RAG_DIR` env, then `<cwd>/kb-rag` | kb-rag checkout directory |

@dsh-external/dsh-kb-rag README · Development：```bash
npm install                 # typescript + @types/node + dsh-tools/cordis types (compile only)
npm run typecheck           # tsc -b
```

Runtime has zero npm dependencies; `src/` is the source of truth and `lib/`
the compiled copy (both shipped).
